quarter.zh: 2027 财年第二季（9 月季度）

en: Record revenue of $1,443M (+27%) beat the ~$1.38B estimate, driven by licensing, up 50% to $773M. Royalties rose only 8% to $670M, about $50M short, as costly memory hurt smartphone volumes, though data-center royalties more than doubled. Non-GAAP EPS was $0.52 against $0.48 expected. The Q3 guide of $1.54B ±$50M and EPS of $0.56 was only in line with consensus near $1.53B. Management said it is more confident of up to $2B of AGI CPU revenue through FY28, with first deliveries in the March quarter.

Shares slipped about 3% after hours, then fell 13.1% on Nov 5 to $166.72 after opening near $172. Selling deepened as investors focused on the royalty shortfall, a sign that record partner chip shipments are not lifting royalties as hoped, and on a guide with no upside, while AI chip stocks sold off broadly. Barclays cut its target to $325 and HSBC to $215; Goldman kept a Sell at $160. The stock is about 29% below its Oct 28 close.
zh: 营收创纪录达 14.43 亿美元（+27%），高于约 13.8 亿美元的预期，主要靠授权收入增长 50% 至 7.73 亿美元。版税收入仅增 8% 至 6.7 亿美元，比预期低约 5000 万美元，原因是内存涨价拖累智能手机出货，但数据中心版税翻倍以上。非 GAAP 每股收益 0.52 美元，预期为 0.48 美元。第三季指引营收 15.4 亿美元 ±5000 万、每股收益 0.56 美元，仅与约 15.3 亿美元的市场预期持平。管理层表示对 FY28 前实现最高 20 亿美元 AGI CPU 收入更有信心，首批交付在 3 月季度。
股价盘后小跌约 3%，11 月 5 日以约 172 美元开盘后收跌 13.1% 至 166.72 美元。投资者聚焦版税不及预期——合作伙伴芯片出货创纪录却未带动版税同步增长——以及没有惊喜的指引，叠加 AI 芯片股普遍招售，卖压加剧。巴克莱将目标价下调至 325 美元，汇丰下调至 215 美元；高盛维持卖出评级，目标价 160 美元。股价较 10 月 28 日收盘低约 29%。

bio.en: Joined Arm in 2013 after seven years at NVIDIA running its computing products business, and led Arm's IP products group before becoming CEO in 2022. Took Arm public in 2023 and is moving it from licensing designs toward selling its own chips.
bio.zh: 在英伟达负责计算产品业务七年后，于 2013 年加入 Arm，曾掌管 IP 产品部门，2022 年出任 CEO。2023 年带领 Arm 上市，正推动公司从授权设计转向销售自研芯片。

bio.en: Joined Arm in 2022 ahead of its 2023 IPO. Previously CFO of Splunk from 2019 and of Groupon, which he took public in 2011, and earlier CFO of Amazon International.
bio.zh: 2022 年加入 Arm，为 2023 年上市做准备。此前 2019 年起任 Splunk CFO，也曾任 Groupon CFO 并于 2011 年带领其上市，更早时担任亚马逊国际业务 CFO。
